name: Phantom Tide
description: Cross-domain maritime and airspace intelligence API for restricted-airspace crossing candidates, source freshness, and future vessel/area intelligence workflows.
env_note: The restricted-airspace endpoint is public and keyless. PHANTOM_TIDE_API_KEY is reserved for future keyed routes and should not be set until Phantom Tide documents those endpoints.
rate_limit_note: Public endpoint is bounded (hours ≤ 72, limit ≤ 500) and pollable via poll_after watermark. No key required. Ask Phantom Tide for private endpoint quotas before enabling maritime/convergence calls.
